svg.title: ADBC logomark dimetric construction grid
svg.text: 3:4 dimetric projection, for the standalone logomark. Every edge lands on one grid of 3‑4‑5 diamonds.
10 × 10 cells. Hole 8 × 8 (80%). Rim 1 cell all round.
Wall 1 cell tall, gap 2, so each layer sits 3 below the last.
Rim and wall are both 1 cell, so every band, black or white, is
Down the axis: rim, wall, space, 1:1:1, for 17 cells. The front
rim of the top layer lands where a 4th layer’s back rim would.
Gap (2) is twice the rim (1); each tab it leaves is exactly 1 cell.
10 wide × 17 tall. The top cell is white rim, so the ink is 10 × 16 (5 : 6).
